surface: Team Bridge — notification arrival band, unread registers, all-organizations rows
head: d0c452142aa

method.capture: harness browser tool, one tab, 1280x720 CSS viewport, screenshot op
method.colour: the PNG carries Display P3 constants (a saturated pixel is up to 47/255 away from its CSS value); every ratio below is computed AFTER a P3 -> sRGB transform. The transform is checked against three values the page reports through computed styles: accent rgb(56,201,106) captured as (103,198,116) -> (56,201,106); surface #2b2721 captured as (42,39,34) -> (43,39,33); elevated #322D22 captured as (49,45,35) -> (50,45,34).
method.sampling: 3x3 CSS-pixel mode at a point inside the row's left padding (x=456 CSS) against the same point on the row above it, so band and ground are measured in one image and the capture's transform cancels

not_captured.real_pointer_hover: the harness browser's action set has no hover; a click leaves :hover matching nothing (control: 'button:hover' -> 0 matches after a click on a rail row). The hovered-row frames put the shipped bg-row-hover utility on the row instead of its hover: variant.
not_captured.prefers_reduced_motion_media_query: no CDP media emulation in the action set. Frame 19 reproduces only the shipped reduced-motion declaration (animation: none on the band) and is measured pixel-identical to the peak frame.
